start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh sunna bhaari lag raha hai. Aap abhi theek aur safe hain, ya kuch hua hai?

turns.line: rectangle ke chaaron sides jodenge, 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30, 160 metre
turns.reply: Kabir, aapne chaaron sides jodkar sahi method lagaya: 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30, yani 160 metre. Ab Bittu ko rule batayiye.
